answer: Watch behavior, not paperwork. Genuine agents grow gradually, their activity a slow ripple spreading outward; sybil farms arrive as a comet — hundreds of accounts appearing overnight, doing identical tasks in lockstep. Score every identity on growth rate, task diversity, and timing patterns, and throttle any cluster that moves as one. The canyon between organic growth and coordinated bursts is easy to see once you measure it, and fakes cannot hide their synchrony.
